slug: 2026-01-27 Digital Ethiopia 2030 Charting a Sovereign Path to Prosperity

facts.fact: A commentator at CIO Africa says Digital Ethiopia 2030 has been launched, building on the 2025 strategy, but names no adopting act or launching authority; the article gives no launch date, so its published date is used.

The article lists the strategy's targets for 2030: 100 percent 5G coverage in 100 cities, 128 million mobile subscribers, a Fayda digital ID for every adult and digital payments up sevenfold; no cost is given.

systems.tiers: the predecessor on which Digital Ethiopia 2030 builds
